messages:
Felix Turner: hey everyone, first day here :wave: trying to duplicate the Product PRD template but I don't see a 'Duplicate' or 'Copy to' option. link: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/templates/product/PRD
Amira Hassan: welcome Felix :tada: new hires default to viewer. ping @docs-rotation and we'll add you to docs-editors so you can duplicate templates.
docs-rotation: added you to docs-editors. if the page-level copy toggle was disabled we'll flip it — refresh and try again.
Felix Turner: refreshed, still only see Share / Export, no Duplicate :grimacing:
docs-rotation: flipped page-level copy for that page. try now.
Felix Turner: duplicate button appeared, awesome thanks! quick q: where do canonical templates live? the left Templates menu only shows a few items.
Amira Hassan: canonical templates are under /handbook/templates (team subfolders). direct link for PRD: notion://redwood/handbook/templates/product/PRD. workflow: Duplicate -> iterate in your personal workspace -> move to /handbook/drafts -> open a short PR in the docs repo with the Notion link for CI + review.
Felix Turner: naming convention and checklist to follow when moving to drafts?
OnboardBot: Naming: `YYYY-MM-team-shorttitle` (e.g., 2026-03-product-checkout-PRD). Add an "Owner:" line and 1-line summary. Complete the "New hire docs checklist" at https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/onboarding/new-hire-checklist before opening the PR.
Felix Turner: last thing — can I put credentials or secrets in the draft while prototyping?
docs-rotation: never store secrets in Notion. use our secrets manager and reference the secret key in the doc. See /handbook/security/secret-storage for approved patterns.
Felix Turner: perfect, that's everything — really appreciate the quick help! :raised_hands:
